text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Stage 3 has finally arrived. The venue is 
even livelier than the previous prelims, 
with all eyes on who will advance to the 
finals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This time, she finally faces Sonon Elfie 
at the same venue. One look at Elfie's 
condition is enough to tell that she is in 
peak form.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Encouraging each other to make it to the 
finals— the final qualifying tournament 
begins!
